Accept Decline Skip to content Menu Products Compressors EQ Overdrive / Boost Amp Recreations Modulation Bass Origin Effects IR Cab Library Accessories & Spares All Products B-Stock Artists News DEALERS M-EQ DRIVER MID BOOSTER & DRIVE M-EQ Driver M-EQ Driver Mid Boost, Overdrive and Vintage Studio Mojo The M-EQ DRIVER is a Mid Booster & Drive pedal, based on a vintage Pultec ® studio EQ. Still sought after today, these legendary passive EQs from the 1950s can be heard on thousands of hit records thanks to their highly musical, versatile EQ curves and the ability to overdrive their push-pull output stage. Rather than making an exact replica, we have chosen to reimagine this classic piece of studio gear as a guitar-oriented, compact pedal. Craft the perfect mid boost, add some studio-inspired saturation or push the pedal’s valve-like output stage into fierce “cocked wah” distortion. With the addition of our Adaptive Circuitry, the M-EQ DRIVER is always responsive and precise, with a character all of its own. £ 215.83 ex VAT Colour: Original Colour: Black Edition Out of stock Colour Choose an option Black Edition Original Clear Selection M-EQ Driver quantity Add to cart Colour: Original Colour: Black Edition Out of stock Colour Choose an option Black Edition Original Clear Selection M-EQ Driver quantity Add to cart original black edition Please enable your browser's JS to load this products data Only Left! Free -Day Shipping Get it by when you order within Get it if you order in Price: × Faster Shipping Dealers Manual FEATURES LIST: Based on the legendary Pultec ® studio EQs of the 1950s Choice of mid boost frequencies Adaptive Cut control responds to volume changes and playing dynamics Transformer-equipped circuitry Valve-like push-pull output stage Ultra-high input impedance High-quality buffered bypass Premium components throughout Designed and built in England   THE DETAILS: The original Pultec ® studio EQs are renowned for having some of the most natural and musical EQ curves in existence, so we recreated the behaviour of this timeless, passive EQ and optimised it for electric guitar. To make sure you’re emphasising just the right part of your signal, the M-EQ DRIVER lets you choose between 0.8, 1.0 and 1.3 KCS mid boost frequencies (yes, we even kept the old “Kilocycles Per Second” label – Kilohertz in the present day). Not only does this versatile mid boost guarantee compatibility with all kinds of guitars but, when pushed harder, can elicit a range of saturation from a classic “mid-hump” overdrive to ferocious, resonant distortion tones. Equipped with a transformer, this carefully developed circuit adds harmonic richness, while faithfully recreating the sonic footprint of an original vintage Pultec ® . Using the MID knob in conjunction with the DRIVE control lets you balance mid boost with overdrive, giving your clean or overdriven tones as much or as little mid-emphasis as you need. To add something new to this classic design, we have equipped the M-EQ DRIVER with our Adaptive Circuitry, applied to the CUT control. Based on the High Frequency Attenuation band of a Pultec ® , the CUT control progressively removes treble as it is increased. With the ADAPT switch engaged, this high-end roll-off is reduced as the pedal cleans up, allowing for a smooth transition from warm overdrive to bright clean tones by adjusting your guitar’s volume knob or playing dynamics.
